title: AMC+ Debuts First Look at The Final Season of The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
summary: Premiering in 2027, Emmy® and Golden Globe® Award-winner Jimmy Smits will join series stars Norman Reedus and Melissa McBride in the highly anticipated new season set in Spain.
body_markdown:
AMC+ unveiled today a first look at the final season of *The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon* , **set to premiere in 2027** . Emmy® and Golden Globe® Award-winner Jimmy Smits ( *NYPD Blue* , *The West Wing* ) joins series stars Norman Reedus and Melissa McBride as *Walking Dead* fan favorites “Daryl” and “Carol” in the highly anticipated new season set in Spain. Watch the final season teaser below:


In the final season, while crossing the ravaged badlands of Spain, “Daryl” (Reedus) and “Carol” (McBride) grasp onto hope – and each other – as uncertainty about their future grows. Smits plays “Captain Alejandro Perkins,” a former U.S. Navy officer and medical doctor who found a unique way to thrive during the apocalypse.


*The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon* also stars Romain Levi, Eduardo Noriega, Óscar Jaenada, Candela Saitta and Hugo Arbués and is executive produced by showrunner David Zabel, Scott M. Gimple, Reedus, McBride, Greg Nicotero, Brian Bockrath, Angela Kang, Jason Richman, Dan Percival and Steve Squillante.
